description: Health and activity of the Bitsocial peer-to-peer network.

options.content:
**Network overview**  ·  [5chan boards](/public-dashboards/fa6f2225e0ea98e116fb6f85d84e0186)

Live health and activity of the Bitsocial peer-to-peer network, measured continuously by the Bitsocial stats monitor.

panels.description: Bitsocial websites plus the newsletter, spam blocker and challenge servers that respond as expected right now.

targets.expr: (sum(max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_service_probe_last_success)) or vector(0)) + (sum(max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_webpage_last_webpage_fetch_success)) or vector(0))

panels.title: Services up

panels.description: IPFS gateways, pubsub providers, HTTP routers, chain providers, seeders and previewers that passed their latest check. Providers without a check result count as down.

targets.expr: (sum(max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_ipfs_gateway_last_comment_fetch_success) or label_replace(vector(0), "ipfs_gateway_url", "https://gateway.forumindex.com", "", "") or label_replace(vector(0), "ipfs_gateway_url", "https://gateway.plebpubsub.xyz", "", "") or label_replace(vector(0), "ipfs_gateway_url", "https://ipfs.io", "", "") or label_replace(vector(0), "ipfs_gateway_url", "https://ipfsgateway.xyz", "", "")) or vector(0)) + (sum(min by (pubsub_provider_url) ({__name__=~"bitsocial_stats_pubsub_provider_last_(publish|subscribe)_success"}) or label_replace(vector(0), "pubsub_provider_url", "http://nocf.pubsubprovider.xyz/api/v0", "", "") or label_replace(vector(0), "pubsub_provider_url", "https://plebpubsub.xyz/api/v0", "", "") or label_replace(vector(0), "pubsub_provider_url", "https://pubsubprovider.xyz/api/v0", "", "") or label_replace(vector(0), "pubsub_provider_url", "https://rannithepleb.com/api/v0", "", "")) or vector(0)) + (sum(max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_http_router_last_get_providers_fetch_success) or label_replace(vector(0), "http_router_url", "https://peers.forumindex.com", "", "") or label_replace(vector(0), "http_router_url", "https://peers.pleb.bot", "", "") or label_replace(vector(0), "http_router_url", "https://peers.plebpubsub.xyz", "", "") or label_replace(vector(0), "http_router_url", "https://routing.lol", "", "")) or vector(0)) + (sum(max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_chain_provider_last_resolve_address_success) or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "chain_provider_url", "https://ethrpc.xyz", "", ""), "chain_ticker", "eth", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "chain_provider_url", "ethers.js", "", ""), "chain_ticker", "eth", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "chain_provider_url", "viem", "", ""), "chain_ticker", "eth", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "chain_provider_url", "https://solrpc.xyz", "", ""), "chain_ticker", "sol", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "chain_provider_url", "web3.js", "", ""), "chain_ticker", "sol", "", "")) or vector(0)) + (sum(max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_seeder_last_community_update_cid_fetch_success) or label_replace(vector(0), "seeder_peer_id", "12D3KooWDfnXqdZfsoqKbcYEDKRttt3adumB5m6tw8YghPwMAz8V", "", "")) or vector(0)) + (sum(max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_previewer_last_comment_preview_fetch_success) or label_replace(vector(0), "previewer_url", "https://pleb.bz", "", "")) or vector(0))

panels.title: Providers up

panels.description: Boards from the official 5chan directories whose latest fetch succeeded and whose latest update is less than 2 hours old.

targets.expr: (sum(((max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_last_community_update_fetch_seconds_since_updated_at{client_id="5chan"}) < bool 7200) * max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_last_community_update_fetch_success{client_id="5chan"})) or (max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_last_community_update_fetch_success{client_id="5chan"}) * 0)) or vector(0))

panels.title: Boards online

panels.description: All-time threads and replies across the official 5chan boards.

targets.expr: sum(max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_all_post_count{client_id="5chan"})) + sum(max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_all_reply_count{client_id="5chan"}))

panels.title: 5chan posts

panels.description: New threads and replies across all 5chan boards within each rolling hour, as reported by each board's own stats.

targets.expr: sum(max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_hour_post_count{client_id="5chan"}) and (max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_last_community_update_fetch_success{client_id="5chan"}) == 1))

sum(max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_hour_reply_count{client_id="5chan"}) and (max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_last_community_update_fetch_success{client_id="5chan"}) == 1))

panels.title: Posts per hour

panels.description: Addresses that posted within the last 24 hours, 7 days and 30 days, summed per board: an address active on several boards is counted once per board.

targets.expr: sum(max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_day_active_user_count{client_id="5chan"}) and (max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_last_community_update_fetch_success{client_id="5chan"}) == 1))
sum(max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_week_active_user_count{client_id="5chan"}))
sum(max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_month_active_user_count{client_id="5chan"}))

panels.title: Active addresses

panels.description: Cumulative threads and replies across all 5chan boards, plus unique posting addresses summed per board.

targets.expr: sum(max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_all_post_count{client_id="5chan"}))
sum(max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_all_reply_count{client_id="5chan"}))
sum(max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_all_active_user_count{client_id="5chan"}))

panels.title: All-time totals

panels.description: Approximate city-level locations of peers that provide board IPNS records through HTTP routers, derived from their public IP addresses. Larger dots mean more peers in that city.

targets.expr: max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_network_ipns_http_routers_peer_location_count)

panels.title: Where peers are

panels.description: Unique peers across all 5chan boards: peers connected to board pubsub topics, and peers that HTTP routers list as providers of board pubsub topics and IPNS records.

targets.expr: sum(max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_network_pubsub_peer_count))
sum(max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_network_pubsub_http_routers_peer_count))
sum(max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_network_ipns_http_routers_peer_count))

panels.title: Peers over time

panels.description: Green while a website or service answers with the expected status and content; red while its check fails.

targets.expr: max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_webpage_last_webpage_fetch_success)
max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_service_probe_last_success)

panels.title: Service uptime

panels.description: How long each successful website and service check took.

targets.expr: max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_webpage_last_webpage_fetch_duration_seconds) and (max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_webpage_last_webpage_fetch_success) == 1)

max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_service_probe_last_duration_seconds) and (max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_service_probe_last_success) == 1)

panels.title: Response time

panels.description: Public infrastructure that Bitsocial clients rely on. Green while the provider passed its latest check: gateways and previewers serve content, pubsub providers publish and subscribe, HTTP routers answer provider lookups, chain providers resolve addresses, and seeders serve board updates.

targets.expr: max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_ipfs_gateway_last_comment_fetch_success) or label_replace(vector(0), "ipfs_gateway_url", "https://gateway.forumindex.com", "", "") or label_replace(vector(0), "ipfs_gateway_url", "https://gateway.plebpubsub.xyz", "", "") or label_replace(vector(0), "ipfs_gateway_url", "https://ipfs.io", "", "") or label_replace(vector(0), "ipfs_gateway_url", "https://ipfsgateway.xyz", "", "")

min by (pubsub_provider_url) ({__name__=~"bitsocial_stats_pubsub_provider_last_(publish|subscribe)_success"}) or label_replace(vector(0), "pubsub_provider_url", "http://nocf.pubsubprovider.xyz/api/v0", "", "") or label_replace(vector(0), "pubsub_provider_url", "https://plebpubsub.xyz/api/v0", "", "") or label_replace(vector(0), "pubsub_provider_url", "https://pubsubprovider.xyz/api/v0", "", "") or label_replace(vector(0), "pubsub_provider_url", "https://rannithepleb.com/api/v0", "", "")

max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_http_router_last_get_providers_fetch_success) or label_replace(vector(0), "http_router_url", "https://peers.forumindex.com", "", "") or label_replace(vector(0), "http_router_url", "https://peers.pleb.bot", "", "") or label_replace(vector(0), "http_router_url", "https://peers.plebpubsub.xyz", "", "") or label_replace(vector(0), "http_router_url", "https://routing.lol", "", "")

max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_chain_provider_last_resolve_address_success) or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "chain_provider_url", "https://ethrpc.xyz", "", ""), "chain_ticker", "eth", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "chain_provider_url", "ethers.js", "", ""), "chain_ticker", "eth", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "chain_provider_url", "viem", "", ""), "chain_ticker", "eth", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "chain_provider_url", "https://solrpc.xyz", "", ""), "chain_ticker", "sol", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "chain_provider_url", "web3.js", "", ""), "chain_ticker", "sol", "", "")

max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_seeder_last_community_update_cid_fetch_success) or label_replace(vector(0), "seeder_peer_id", "12D3KooWDfnXqdZfsoqKbcYEDKRttt3adumB5m6tw8YghPwMAz8V", "", "")

max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_previewer_last_comment_preview_fetch_success) or label_replace(vector(0), "previewer_url", "https://pleb.bz", "", "")

panels.title: Provider uptime

panels.description: Time to fetch a comment through each gateway. Gaps mean the fetch failed.

targets.expr: max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_ipfs_gateway_last_comment_fetch_duration_seconds) and (max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_ipfs_gateway_last_comment_fetch_success) == 1)

panels.title: Comment fetch time

panels.description: Share of 5chan boards whose IPNS record each gateway resolved on its latest check.

targets.expr: avg by (ipfs_gateway_url) (max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_ipfs_gateway_last_community_ipns_fetch_success))

panels.title: Boards served

panels.description: Time for each pubsub provider to publish a test message. Gaps mean the check failed.

targets.expr: max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_pubsub_provider_last_publish_duration_seconds) and (max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_pubsub_provider_last_publish_success) == 1)

panels.title: Publish time

panels.description: Time for each pubsub provider to subscribe a test message. Gaps mean the check failed.

targets.expr: max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_pubsub_provider_last_subscribe_duration_seconds) and (max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_pubsub_provider_last_subscribe_success) == 1)

panels.title: Subscribe time

panels.description: Time for each HTTP router to answer a providers lookup. Gaps mean the lookup failed.

targets.expr: max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_http_router_last_get_providers_fetch_duration_seconds) and (max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_http_router_last_get_providers_fetch_success) == 1)

panels.title: Provider lookup time

panels.description: Share of 5chan boards for which each HTTP router returned at least one IPNS record provider.

targets.expr: (count by (http_router_url) ((max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_http_router_last_community_ipns_get_providers_fetch_provider_count) > 0) and (max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_http_router_last_community_ipns_get_providers_fetch_success) == 1)) or count by (http_router_url) (max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_http_router_last_community_ipns_get_providers_fetch_success)) * 0) / count by (http_router_url) (max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_http_router_last_community_ipns_get_providers_fetch_success))

panels.title: Boards with providers

panels.description: Time for each chain provider to resolve a test address. Gaps mean the resolution failed.

targets.expr: max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_chain_provider_last_resolve_address_duration_seconds) and (max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_chain_provider_last_resolve_address_success) == 1)

panels.title: Address resolve time

panels.description: Time to fetch a board update from each seeder. Gaps mean the fetch failed.

targets.expr: max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_seeder_last_community_update_cid_fetch_duration_seconds) and (max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_seeder_last_community_update_cid_fetch_success) == 1)

panels.title: Seeder update fetch time

panels.description: Time to render a comment preview through each previewer. Gaps mean the fetch failed.

targets.expr: max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_previewer_last_comment_preview_fetch_duration_seconds) and (max without(client_id, instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_previewer_last_comment_preview_fetch_success) == 1)

panels.title: Previewer fetch time
